ui.settings.model.model_setting_options..tone: Compact, neutral state readout; comma-separated English facts are one message, not fragments.
ui.settings.model.model_setting_options..length: Single secondary line under the model name; keep brief.
ui.settings.model.model_setting_options..note: Names the provider and optionally whether it is accessed via an aggregator and whether a usable provider credential is present. This is not a claim that the remote/local service is currently running.

placeholders.provider: Provider display name from the registry or capitalized provider ID. Insert verbatim.
placeholders.aggregated: Stable select token yes/no. yes means this model is accessed through an aggregator. Never translate the selector tokens.
placeholders.credential: Stable select token unknown/missing/signed_in. unknown omits the credential claim; missing means no usable credential; signed_in means a provider credential is held. Never translate the selector tokens.
